scope: Read-only inspection of every configured workflow and entire Actions run history, across all branches and actors. Empty history also means no queued/in-progress/completed runs or old-run rerun attempts to account for on the current UTC day.
proposedBatch: One preview source branch push, one pull request and verified merge; no media release, dispatch, rerun, workflow or deployment configuration change.
coordination: Coordinator is the sole remote writer. Recheck run history and workflow configuration immediately before each subsequent trigger-capable action; this saved snapshot does not grant future budget exceptions.
approvalPolicy: Apply the current user policy at action time; retain required checks and service behavior. No numeric permission threshold is copied into project memory.
